verdict_text:
YES — the script reproduces the required result exactly.

`keep_index(1, 6144, 768)` yields the 8 head blocks minus block 5, i.e. rows `0..3839` then `4608..6143` in order, applied along dim 0 to both `query_key_value.weight` and `.bias`; `keep_index(1, 2048, 256)` applied along dim 1 of `attention.dense.weight` keeps columns `0..1279` then `1536..2047`. All 16 layers are covered, no other tensor is touched, names are unchanged, dtype is preserved by `index_select`, and the four required checks (three shapes plus the 244-tensor count) are asserted before `save_file` writes the single `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
